settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.signatureDescription: Add a signature that will be appended to your outgoing emails.
settings.pushDescription: Get notified on this device when new mail arrives (across all mailboxes).
settings.pushError: Failed to update push notification settings
settings.spamFilterDescription: For mail that already passed the SPF/DKIM/DMARC first-pass filter, setting an API key enables a Claude-based second-pass check; mail it flags as spam is routed to the Spam folder. With no key configured, this second pass is skipped entirely (the Claude API is never called).
settings.spamFilterApiKeyPlaceholderConfigured: Enter a new value to change it
settings.spamFilterConfirmRemove: Are you sure you want to remove the saved API key?
settings.deletionLockDescription: While this is on, the mailbox cannot be deleted. Leave it on for mailboxes you actually use.
settings.deletionLockConfirmUnlock: Turn off the deletion lock? The mailbox becomes deletable once it is off.
settings.deleteMailboxDescription: Removes the mailbox from the list. By default the stored mail is kept, so recreating the same address brings it back.
settings.deleteMailboxLockedHint: The deletion lock is on. Turn it off above before deleting.
settings.deleteMailboxPurgeLabel: Also destroy the stored mail (every message, attachment and folder is erased; this cannot be undone)
settings.deleteMailboxConfirm: Remove this mailbox from the list?
settings.deleteMailboxConfirmPurge: Permanently delete this mailbox and every message and attachment stored in it? This cannot be undone.
settings.exportNote: Downloads every message in this mailbox as an mbox archive, which Thunderbird and most other clients can import. Received mail is written out exactly as it arrived; mail composed here is rebuilt, attachments included.
settings.restoreNote: Reads an mbox archive taken here and puts the messages back, into the folders they were in and with the read and starred marks they had. Running it twice is safe: a message already here is skipped. A folder the archive names but this mailbox does not have is created.
settings.restoreFailed: The archive could not be read.
settings.autoBackupDescription: Saves the whole mailbox as an mbox archive at the interval you choose. Once there are more than you asked to keep, the oldest go.
settings.autoBackupKeepNote: The number of copies can be raised but not lowered (currently no lower than {keep}). Lowering it would be a delete button with a delay, since the next run would drop the older archives. Lowering it needs Cloudflare access.
settings.autoBackupWindowNote: Nothing on this screen deletes a backup. The only archives that go are the ones past the count you set, and separately the newest archive of each of the last 12 months is always kept. If the mail is destroyed, that leaves about a year to notice and put it back.
